name: $k$-Block Littlestone Dimension / VC Dimension
details: A VC-shattered set gives a level-constant $k$-block tree.
proof: If $S=\{x_1,\ldots,x_d\}$ is VC-shattered, label every node on level $i$ by $x_i$. This is a shattered tree of depth $d$ and satisfies every $k$-block constraint. Hence $\mathrm B_k(\mathcal H)\ge\operatorname{VC}(\mathcal H)$ for every fixed $k>2$.
